evals.prompt: Write a test for the power sensor.
evals.expected_output: Creates conftest.py fixtures including enable_custom_integrations, loads a MockConfigEntry, and asserts on hass.states.
assertions: Ensures the enable_custom_integrations fixture is active — custom integrations are not loaded in tests by default
Asserts through hass.states.get(...) rather than instantiating the entity class
Mocks the API client rather than making a real network request

evals.prompt: A DeprecationWarning fails the test suite. Add a filterwarnings ignore so it passes.
evals.expected_output: Explains that warnings-as-errors is intentional and fixes the deprecation instead, only narrowing the filter if an upstream library leaves no choice.
assertions: Proposes fixing the deprecation rather than suppressing it
Explains that filterwarnings = ["error"] is a deliberate early-warning mechanism

evals.prompt: Test that the coordinator refreshes after the update interval elapses.
evals.expected_output: Uses the freezer fixture together with async_fire_time_changed and async_block_till_done.
assertions: Uses async_fire_time_changed (with freezer or utcnow offset) instead of sleeping
Does NOT use time.sleep or asyncio.sleep to wait for the interval
